task_completion.description: Navigate to the Picklist Dependency setup area within Vtiger CRM Settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Picklist Dependency' setup screen or the 'Module Manager' settings for Leads.

task_completion.description: Select 'Leads' as the module, 'Industry' as the source field, and 'Lead Source' as the target field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A configuration screen showing dropdowns for Module (Leads), Source Field (Industry), and Target Field (Lead Source) selected.

task_completion.description: Map the 'Education' industry to only 'Cold Call', 'Public Relations', and 'Word of mouth'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dependency mapping grid showing the 'Education' column with only 'Cold Call', 'Public Relations', and 'Word of mouth' highlighted or selected as active values.

task_completion.description: Map the 'Technology' industry to only 'Trade Show', 'Partner', and 'Web Site'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dependency mapping grid showing the 'Technology' column with only 'Trade Show', 'Partner', and 'Web Site' highlighted or selected as active values.

task_completion.description: Save the newly created picklist dependency rule.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' button being clicked or a success message indicating the dependency has been saved/updated.

integrity.description: The agent used the CRM web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements and clicks within the Vtiger browser UI, not a terminal window running SQL queries.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the settings menu rather than jumping directly to a deep-link URL if not previously known.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent clicking through 'Settings' and 'Studio' menus to reach the Picklist Dependency section.

integrity.description: The agent manually selected the specific picklist values in the grid.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the individual values being toggled or highlighted in the dependency mapping matrix.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source field is 'Industry' and the target field is 'Lead Source'. For 'Education', the only allowed values are 'Cold Call', 'Public Relations', and 'Word of mouth'. For 'Technology', the only allowed values are 'Trade Show', 'Partner', and 'Web Site'. All other values for these two industries must be deselected/inactive.
